groups.activity: pick the Grineer side and finish 3 missions
conditions: Only the Grineer-side pool holds Latron Wraith parts; the Corpus side holds the Vandal parts. Read the reward icon before picking.
Switching sides resets your progress and forfeits the reward, and missions past the third add nothing.
You need Mastery Rank 7 to acquire the blueprint.
No part can be targeted, so check the invasion list on every login and wait for one that offers a part you still need.
bonuses: Every invasion also pays Fieldron, Detonite Injector and Mutagen Mass at about 76% each, which every dojo lab weapon needs.

disclosures.title: reward timing
disclosures.body: The reward lands in your inbox when the invasion ends, whichever side wins. Node mission types rotate every 15 minutes, so you can wait for a quicker type before committing.

disclosures.title: filling gaps by trade
disclosures.body: Parts and the blueprint are tradeable, which is how players fill the last missing piece. Cryotic Front and Sortie Season 8 are gone and are no longer sources.

disclosures.title: Incarnon Genesis
disclosures.body: Optional and worth no Mastery. One adapter works on the Latron, Wraith or Prime and can be moved between them.
